items.text: Phase 0: brainstorming and every matching plugin-dev:* skill invoked (evidence: skills invoked)
Phase 1: goal restated and confirmed; user-only decisions asked (evidence: the user's words)
Phase 2: primary docs and 6-month changelog read; every source has an adopt/reject verdict (evidence: URLs, verdict count)
Phase 3: real tool exercised, edge cases tested, live captures done; facts tagged [observed]/[doc] (evidence: commands run)
Phase 4: every surface decided; skill boundaries, agents, workflows, and instructions-vs-script justified (evidence: spec section)
Phase 5: Requirements table and platform matrix filled for any user (evidence: spec section)
Phase 6: non-goals, failure modes, fail-closed/open per event (evidence: spec section)
Phase 7: tests, at least 3 evals, open live checks listed (evidence: spec section)
Phase 8: spec written with one canonical section and all required sections
items.verify: f=$(ls docs/superpowers/specs/*-"$CHECKLIST_SUBJECT"-design.md 2>/dev/null | tail -1); test -n "$f" || { echo "no spec for $CHECKLIST_SUBJECT"; exit 1; }; for h in 'Requirements' 'Non-goals' 'Failure modes' 'Surfaces' 'References' 'Verification'; do grep -qi "^#.*$h" "$f" || { echo "$f: missing a heading containing '$h'"; exit 1; }; done

items.text: Phase 8: the user approved or adjusted the design; nothing built before it (evidence: the user's words)
